justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: No comparative RCTs of SCS vs non-SCS outcomes; sports injury management knowledge advanced.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: ABPTS exam plus 2,000 hours sports clinical experience; major career investment.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to sports medicine, athletic training, and injury prevention settings; limited outside sports contexts.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No SCS-specific billing premium; sports medicine PT billed under standard codes.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Steady employer demand in sports medicine, collegiate athletic, and professional sports settings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Athletes value working with sports-specialized clinicians.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Athletes and active adults are among the highest-paying cash-pay segments in PT.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: SCS supports premium sports performance and return-to-sport pricing.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Genuinely rare credential; differentiates strongly in sports-med markets.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Sports practices scale well with multiple SCS clinicians delivering structured RTS programs.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Recognized by serious athletes, coaches, and referral sources more than most credentials.
justifications.business.efficiency: Requires emergency cert, hours, exam; time-intensive pathway.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Highly respected ABPTS board cert; strong weight for sports/ortho faculty roles.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Active research community around sports PT and RTS.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Highly relevant to sports, ortho, and clinical-decision-making curricula.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong RCT base in ACL, RTS, and tendinopathy literature.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred in sports-track faculty postings, though fewer such roles exist than ortho.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Lengthy pathway with emergency care and exam; meaningful time cost.
